Welcome to our August newsletter! This month, we focused on three theme weeks that highlight how innovation, technology and global collaboration are shaping the future of the Volkswagen Group. Through One Group. Many Roads, we highlighted how regions across the globe contribute their unique strengths to a shared mobility vision. Our AI in Engineering theme week showed how artificial intelligence is accelerating development and driving innovation. We also explored the Charging & Energy Ecosystem, from battery cell production at PowerCo to charging and energy solutions from Elli , highlighting how the Volkswagen Group is enabling a connected and sustainable electric future. 🔍 Explore the 3️⃣ highlights that shaped this month: 🌍1. One Group, Many Roads Our One Group, Many Roads theme week showcased how mobility is shaped differently across regions while being united by a shared vision. Across five markets, the series highlighted the many ways in which regional expertise, customer focus and innovation contribute to the Volkswagen Group's success. From Europe's expertise in engineering, battery development and large-scale transformation, to South America’s focus on practical innovation, affordability and adaptability, each market contributes its own strengths and perspectives. The series also highlighted Volkswagen Group’s activities in North America, including local vehicle and battery production, India’s focus on localization through the INDIA 2.0 initiative, and China’s role as a key development hub for intelligent connected vehicles and advanced driver assistance systems. While the approaches may differ, all regions share a common goal: developing mobility solutions that meet local customer needs while contributing to the Volkswagen Group’s global ambitions. Together, these examples demonstrate how regional expertise, local customer focus and innovation help shape the future of mobility across the Volkswagen Group. 🤖 2. AI in Engineering Our AI in Engineering theme week explored how artificial intelligence is transforming automotive development across the Volkswagen Group. From AI-powered virtual twins that support design, development, software testing and validation to faster decision-making and more efficient processes, the goal is clear: bringing innovations to customers more quickly.
